subject: Aster Systems — Capacity expansion & invoice remit consolidation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astersys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Aster Systems Accounting <acct@astersys.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity increase + invoice routing (PO attached)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team is ready to move forward with the additional capacity we discussed (approx. 400k tokens/month uplift). Finance asked me to loop back on two items before we finalize the PO:

1) Can Redwood consolidate invoices to our central accounting mailbox (acct@astersys.com)?
2) We need a copy of Redwood's W-9 to attach to our vendor record and for the PO.

I've attached the signed PO (PO-8742-Aster.pdf) — it references Net 60 payment terms. If you need a different remit or a specific invoice contact name, let me know and I can update the PO.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platforms — Aster Systems
liam.oconnor@astersys.com
Attachment: PO-8742-Aster.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astersys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase + invoice routing (PO attached)

Hi Liam — great to hear the team is ready. Quick notes below and next steps so procurement can close this out: 

- We can consolidate invoices to acct@astersys.com — that's fine. Please confirm whether you prefer a single monthly invoice or one per committed purchase order (we usually do one monthly invoice per account for committed capacity).
- I'll attach our current W-9 in a follow-up (sending from Finance to make sure it's the most recent).
- Net 60 is acceptable; I'll ask Finance to confirm and send a proforma invoice tied to PO-8742.

Looping in Ben (Billing & AR) and Marissa (Renewals) to coordinate the proforma and the remit contact. Ben — can you prepare a proforma that hits Net 60 and specifies "acct@astersys.com" as the invoice recipient? Also include the consolidated monthly invoice option in case they want one invoice for all committed capacity.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astersys.com>, Aster Systems Accounting <acct@astersys.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase + invoice routing (PO attached)

Thanks Naomi — assigning this to Billing. Liam/Accounting team: attaching our standard W-9 and a draft proforma that reflects the PO and Net 60 terms. In the proforma I've included two invoice paths:

A) Monthly consolidated invoice to acct@astersys.com (single line item for committed capacity use)
B) Per-PO invoicing (one invoice referencing PO-8742)

Please confirm which you prefer and whether the remit should still be the US treasury account listed on the proforma (Bank of Redwood — ACH details). If your procurement needs the invoice to reference a specific legal entity name (e.g., Aster Systems, Inc. vs Aster Systems LLC) let us know and we'll update.

Attachments: Aster_W9_2025.pdf (application/pdf), proforma-invoice-Aster-2025.xlsx (spreadsheet)

—Ben Carter
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Aster Systems Accounting <acct@astersys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase + invoice routing (PO attached)

Hi Ben / Naomi,

Thanks for the proforma and W-9. We prefer option A — consolidated monthly invoice to acct@astersys.com. Confirming the legal name should be Aster Systems, Inc. and please reference PO-8742 on the invoice for traceability.

Also, our AP team needs a vendor remittance contact on the invoice (name, email). Please include: 
- Accounts Payable (remit) — acct@astersys.com

We have the PO attached and I've uploaded it to our procurement portal. If you need a signed DocuSign of the proforma, let us know and we can route it.

Regards,
Aster Systems Accounting
acct@astersys.com
Attachment: PO-8742-Aster.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astersys.com>, Aster Systems Accounting <acct@astersys.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase + invoice routing (PO attached)

Thanks everyone — I have recorded the preference for consolidated monthly invoices to acct@astersys.com with legal name Aster Systems, Inc. Ben: please finalize the proforma with Net 60, include remit contact line, and attach the W-9.

Kimberly from Contracts: could you confirm whether we need an executed amendment to the existing SOW to reflect the 400k token uplift or if the PO alone is sufficient for accounting to recognize the commitment? If an amendment is required we can prepare a short addendum and route via DocuSign.

Next steps (owners):
- Ben Carter: Final proforma & attach W-9 (by 12/03)
- Naomi Feldman: Confirm PO upload in HubSpot and close deal stage to "Committed" once proforma is returned
- Kimberly Park: Confirm whether amendment required (contractual)

Marissa Cole
Renewals Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
